title: C: long failure by looping between receptacles
initial_observation:
-= Welcome to TextWorld, ALFRED! =-

Your task is to: put some creditcard on drawer.
shows: After checking drawer 1 and cabinets 1-4, the agent starts cycling `go to shelf 1` / `go to shelf 2` / cabinet 1..4 / drawer 1 without ever completing the search, and exhausts the 30-step budget.
why_interesting: The typical failure of C on pick-and-place: revisiting receptacles it has already seen, with no record of what was checked (17 repeated commands).
